propositions: materialize_tickets writes the entire ~620 MiB ticket tree (69,984 blobs) fresh on each review without reuse, despite adjacent commits differing by single files
the cache key (tickets branch tip) advances every ~26 seconds with zero reuse of prior entries, converting a bounded cache into an append-only log of full copies
hardlinking and inode sharing are structurally absent across entries, producing 10^5x write amplification (one-file delta materializes 300-file tree)
concurrent agents multiply the per-entry 620 MiB write cost, creating measurable CPU spikes and resource starvation as multiple processes contend for I/O and disk space

the fix hardens integrity of snapshot attestation by using hardlinks between adjacent trees for unchanged paths while forcing unshareable files like .ticket-write.lock to rewrite, keeping content integrity unchanged but eliminating write amplification
